name: argus-tui
description: Ink terminal frontend for the argus-skill autonomous-research daemon. A client of the argus-skill webapi (events over WS, snapshots/commands over REST).

scripts.build: python -m argus_skill.release_tools.generate_event_types --check && python -m argus_skill.release_tools.generate_event_fixtures --check && python -m argus_skill.release_tools.generate_manifest --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:bundle
